visual.name: orderLineComments
visual.description: Read-only Orders grid with per-line comment threads backed by Cloudflare D1

dataRoles.name: columns
dataRoles.description: Drag any model fields here (sales order line grain). Reorder by drag in the visual. Use the Table › Comment columns position setting to slot the Comments / Latest comment columns at any position.

dataRoles.name: orderLineId
dataRoles.description: Hidden join key: the Orders [Order Line ID] string (e.g. "00010,74,CM,4.000"). Used to look up the comment thread for each row.

dataRoles.name: hiddenColumns
dataRoles.description: Fields here are not displayed in the visual but are included in Power BI's standard 'Export data' output.

dataRoles.name: currentUser
dataRoles.description: Bind a measure like CurrentUserEmail = USERPRINCIPALNAME() here. Used to look up the viewer's role so listed users can add/edit/delete comments.

dataRoles.name: companyList
dataRoles.description: Optional. Supplies the tick-list of Order Companies in the People panel. Prefer a MEASURE returning the comma-separated full list ([Company List (All)]) — any column here is a group-by, so page filters prune it to the companies already on screen and the picker cannot offer the rest. A column still works (use a FACT column, never a dimension); leave empty and the list is derived from the Order Line ID at no cost.
